nba.playoff_max_deficit_comeback_rate.measurement_fix: From play-by-play for 15 seasons compute for each game the maximum deficit faced by the eventual winner, M. nba.stat_rate_posterior.measurement_fix: Per stat s in {points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, 3PM} on a per-36-minute basis: prior mean = nba.preseason projection (last-two-season blend with aging adjustment). n_prior,s is estimated by backtest on 10 seasons as the value that minimises out-of-sample squared error of the next-20-game per-36 rate, via method of moments n_prior = sigma2_within/sigma2_between (report the estimate, not a fixed 25/35/40). Posterior mean = (n_prior x prior + n x observed)/(n_prior + n) using games with minutes weights; posterior sd = sqrt(sigma2_within/(n_prior + n) x overdispersion factor). Convert to per-game using projected minutes from nba.minutes. As-of: games before tip.

nba.team_stat_pair_difference_model.measurement_fix: For a team stat X (e.g. 3PM): mean_X = attempts_X x rate_X using opponent-adjusted attempts and rates (20-game half-life, rate shrunk with k=150 attempts); each team's count ~ negative binomial with dispersion estimated from 3 seasons of team-games. Correlation rho between the two teams' counts = empirical correlation of residual counts across the same game over 3 seasons, modelled as a linear function of the game's total possessions (pace) and pooled by stat; use a Gaussian copula with this rho to couple the two NB marginals. Compute P(A>B) and P(tie) by summing the joint pmf; apply the blowout correction by increasing the trailing team's 3PA rate by the coefficient estimated from the margin-conditional attempt rate (nba.three_att_script_elasticity). As-of: games before tip.
